track_provenance.warning: Color track continuity in generated images is not proven anatomical left/right identity in the real source recording

rules: One realistic middle-school boy with an unchanged face, normal soft youth anatomy, outfit and location for the entire uninterrupted clip
Exactly two arms and two legs, no ghosted or translucent duplicates, no blended still-image transitions
The orange near-side wrist and ankle retain the same physical limb ownership through both jumps; the teal far-side wrist and ankle likewise remain paired
The physical fore/aft leg and opposite-arm assignments change twice; NEVER relabel limbs by screen-left position
Both arms remain extended approximately shoulder high, forward and backward; no bent running-arm pump
Both feet are visibly above the ground during EACH of two airborne exchanges and land naturally without ballet toes
The final posture and contact points match the opening posture; no cut, camera movement, instant leg teleport or fade
